sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied san-rafael-elementary-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. Compact roof-filled site: diagonal-roof northwest canopy, narrow west-edge crowns, small southeast crown and two visibly green narrow gaps beside classroom ends. Central and east links stay narrow; no lawn or hedge inferred from shadows. Northwest crowns beyond the mapped parent can overhang it but trunks stay inside. Diagonal upper roof, long eastern strip and lower central strip; no lawn inferred from shadowed narrow gaps. Independent excluded check errors: 2.90 m, 0.91 m. Visible crown centers are fitted to clear trunks within the observed crown footprint (maximum seven metres); crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Crown widths in the dense belts are estimated from image pixels against their matched local roof scale; existing circular crowns approximate irregular/elliptical image crowns. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Planted islands take precedence over exposed paving; ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
